name: Mystic Tattoo
body:
You inscribe your spell power into your skin.

Prerequisite(s) Spell Focus, Elemental Focus or other feat that increases the DCs of spells cast.

Benefit(s) You can spend 100 gp per bonus to apply your bonus to spell DCs from feats to your caster level checks. This creates a tattoo of your choosing that exemplifies the kind of spells being augmented in this way. Each tattoo inscribed affects spells from one feat type. So, if you have Spell Focus (evocation) and Elemental Focus (fire), you could get a burning skeleton tattoo to improve the caster level check bonus to your fire spells, not fire spells and evocation spells even if the spell is an evocation-fire spell. You can get a second tattoo of mystic runes to also apply the evocation bonus later.
